name: Annie Eliot Trumbull
bio: Annie Eliot Trumbull (1857–1949) was born at Hartford, Connecticut, where she spent her life.
She wrote novels and stories, among them White Birches (1893) and Mistress Content Cradock (1899), and occasional verse.

poems.title: To O. S. C.
poems.author: Annie Eliot Trumbull
poems.collection: An American Anthology, 1787–1900, ed. Edmund Clarence Stedman (1900)
poems.text:
Spirit of “fire and dew,”
  Whither hast fled?
Thy soul they never knew
  Who call thee dead.

Deep thoughts of why and how
  Shadowed thine eyes:
Thou hast the answers now
  Straight from the skies.

Thrilled with a double power,
  Nature and Art,—
Dowered with a double dower,
  Reason and heart,—

Not souls like thine, in vain
  God fashioneth;
Leadeth them forth again,
  Gently, by death.
